verified_behavior: Every configured AI task has an explicit fallback mode and user-facing description; an import-time assertion prevents the policy catalog from silently omitting a newly added task.
Matching and filtering produce a numeric deterministic match with all AI task providers disabled.
The factual document workflow prepares a resume and cover letter from the selected profile and posting. Resume provenance includes approved fact identifiers and the current profile version.
The test patches provider construction to raise if the no-AI matching or document path attempts provider inference.

The settings API returns fallback capabilities while leaving persisted per-profile task configuration unchanged. The UI reports all seven behaviors and clears them when switching profiles until the selected profile response arrives.
The browser test verifies visible capability labels, profile task-settings persistence across reload, and isolation between profiles.
limitations: No delayed task queue is claimed; tasks without deterministic behavior are explicitly UNAVAILABLE.

The complete suite uses synthetic fixtures and temporary SQLite stores. One optional live PostgreSQL test was skipped because PostgreSQL was not configured; no migration or live PostgreSQL claim is made.
Hosted Actions and hosted reviewers were NOT_RUN under the active local-only policy. Their status is not represented as PASS.
No product AI provider was invoked, no paid/cloud service was contacted, and external application submission remained OFF.
